maximum_depth_rule: All 343 canonical Phase 9 Reviewed statements are retained exactly once. Counts from the full plan, individual-plan hierarchy, booklet, and leaflet are not reinterpreted as independent comparable KPI inventories.
version_boundary: The fiscal 2025 to 2028 fourth plan, the third-plan administrative evaluation, Ikiiki indicators, resident satisfaction, and regional revitalization KPIs remain separate versions and analytical layers.
non_goals: Do not infer records from the registered contact-list document with zero reviewed rows.
Do not collapse possible repeated plan expressions across document editions.
Do not convert resident satisfaction into a policy achievement rate.
Do not calculate policy achievement, causality, or cross-prefecture ranking.
